knowledge:
- key_parameters: use_clusters=Required in create_domino() to assess signaling on a per-cluster/cell-type basis rather than broadly across the dataset ;; use_complexes=Decides in create_domino() if receptors functioning in heteromeric complexes are considered; if TRUE, a complex is linked to a TF only if a majority of component genes meet the correlation threshold ;; remove_rec_dropout=Decides in create_domino() and cor_scatter() whether receptor values of zero are excluded from correlation calculations to reduce dropout effects ;; min_tf_pval=Threshold in build_domino() for the Wilcoxon rank-sum test p-value of differential TF activity ;; rec_tf_cor_threshold=Minimum Spearman correlation coefficient in build_domino() between receptor expression and TF activity ;; min_rec_percentage=Minimum percentage of cells within a cluster that must express a receptor for it to be called active in build_domino() ;; max_tf_per_clust=Maximum number of active TFs to retain per cluster in build_domino() (can be set to Inf) ;; max_rec_per_tf=Maximum number of receptors linked to any one TF in build_domino() (can be set to Inf)
- alternatives: SCENIC is used for TF activity and regulon inference, but alternative methods can be used since the input format is a list of target genes. CellPhoneDB is used for ligand-receptor interactions, but alternative or updated reference databases can be used by formatting them as a uniform rl_map data frame.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have scRNA-seq data and want to map cell-cell communication networks by correlating transcription factor activation (e.g., from SCENIC) with receptor and ligand expression across cell clusters.
- pitfalls: The AUC matrix from SCENIC is loaded in a cell x TF orientation and must be transposed to TF x cell orientation before use. pySCENIC appends "(+)" to TF names, which are converted to "..." upon loading into R; these should be removed using gsub() to avoid querying issues. Ligand and receptor expression can only be assessed for genes included in the z_scores matrix; ensure that all genes of interest are included in the rows of the z_scores matrix (standard pipelines often store only highly variable genes in scaled slots, which might miss critical ligands and receptors). The remove_rec_dropout argument in cor_scatter() must match the parameter used when the domino object was built.

workflows.name: domino_signaling_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform cell-cell communication and intracellular TF activation analysis from scRNA-seq data using a Domino object.
workflows.stages:
1. Load and format SCENIC regulons using create_regulon_list_scenic
2. Transpose and clean SCENIC AUC matrix
3. Load and parse CellPhoneDB database files into an rl_map using create_rl_map_cellphonedb
4. Extract counts, z-scores, and cluster labels from SingleCellExperiment
5. Initialize the Domino object using create_domino
6. Finalize the Domino network using build_domino
7. Access results using dom_* functions and visualize using heatmaps, network plots, and circos plots
workflows.code:
regulons <- read.csv(scenic_regulon)
auc <- read.table(scenic_auc,
    header = TRUE, row.names = 1,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = ","
)
regulons <- regulons[-1:-2, ]
colnames(regulons) <- c(
    "TF", "MotifID", "AUC", "NES", "MotifSimilarityQvalue", "OrthologousIdentity",
    "Annotation", "Context", "TargetGenes", "RankAtMax"
)
regulon_list <- create_regulon_list_scenic(regulons = regulons)
auc_in <- as.data.frame(t(auc))
rownames(auc_in) <- gsub("\\.\\.\\.$", "", rownames(auc_in))
complexes <- read.csv(
    paste0(
        cellphone_data, "/complex_input.csv"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
genes <- read.csv(
    paste0(
        cellphone_data, "/gene_input.csv"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
interactions <- read.csv(
    paste0(
        cellphone_data, "/interaction_input.csv"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
proteins <- read.csv(
    paste0(
        cellphone_data, "/protein_input.csv"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
rl_map <- create_rl_map_cellphonedb(
    genes = genes,
    proteins = proteins,
    interactions = interactions,
    complexes = complexes,
    database_name = "CellPhoneDB_v4.0"
)
col_int_df <- data.frame(
    "int_pair" = "a11b1 complex & COLA1_HUMAN",
    "name_A" = "a11b1 complex", "uniprot_A" = "P05556,Q9UKX5", "gene_A" = "ITB1,ITA11", "type_A" = "R",
    "name_B" = "COLA1_HUMAN", "uniprot_B" = "P02452,P08123", "gene_B" = "COL1A1,COL1A2", "type_B" = "L",
    "annotation_strategy" = "manual", "source" = "manual", "database_name" = "manual"
)
rl_map_append <- rbind(col_int_df, rl_map)
counts = assay(pbmc, "counts")
logcounts = assay(pbmc, "logcounts")
logcounts = logcounts[rowSums(logcounts) > 0, ]
z_scores = t(scale(t(logcounts)))
clusters = factor(pbmc$cell_type)
names(clusters) = colnames(pbmc)
pbmc_dom <- create_domino(
    rl_map = rl_map,
    features = auc_in,
    counts = counts,
    z_scores = z_scores,
    clusters = clusters,
    tf_targets = regulon_list,
    use_clusters = TRUE,
    use_complexes = TRUE,
    remove_rec_dropout = FALSE
)
pbmc_dom <- build_domino(
    dom = pbmc_dom,
    min_tf_pval = .001,
    max_tf_per_clust = 25,
    max_rec_per_tf = 25,
    rec_tf_cor_threshold = .25,
    min_rec_percentage = 0.1
)
feat_heatmap(pbmc_dom,
    norm = TRUE, bool = FALSE, use_raster = FALSE,
    row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 4)
)
signaling_network(pbmc_dom, edge_weight = 0.5, max_thresh = 3)
gene_network(pbmc_dom, clust = "dendritic_cell", layout = "grid")
gene_network(pbmc_dom,
    clust = "dendritic_cell", OutgoingSignalingClust = "CD14_monocyte",
    layout = "grid"
)
incoming_signaling_heatmap(pbmc_dom, rec_clust = "dendritic_cell", max_thresh = 2.5, use_raster = FALSE)
circos_ligand_receptor(pbmc_dom, receptor = "CD74")
dom_clusters(dom)
count_matrix <- dom_counts(dom)
z_matrix <- dom_zscores(dom)
activation_matrix <- dom_tf_activation(dom)
dom_database(dom)
db_matrix <- dom_database(dom, name_only = FALSE)
de_matrix <- dom_de(dom)
cor_matrix <- dom_correlations(dom)
complex_links <- dom_linkages(dom, link_type = "complexes")
incoming_links <- dom_linkages(dom, link_type = "incoming-ligand", by_cluster = TRUE)
dc_tfs <- dom_network_items(dom, "dendritic_cell", return = "features")
signal_matrix <- dom_signaling(dom)
dc_matrix <- dom_signaling(dom, "dendritic_cell")
dom_info(dom)
cor_heatmap(dom, title = "PBMC R-TF Correlations", column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8))
cor_heatmap(dom, bool = TRUE, bool_thresh = 0.25)
cor_heatmap(dom, bool = FALSE, mark_connections = TRUE)
cor_heatmap(dom, feats = tfs, recs = receptors)
cor_heatmap(dom, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, column_title = "Heatmap Without Clustering", column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 4))
feat_heatmap(dom, min_thresh = 0.1, max_thresh = 0.6, norm = TRUE, bool = FALSE, use_raster = FALSE)
incoming_signaling_heatmap(dom, "CD8_T_cell")
incoming_signaling_heatmap(dom, "CD8_T_cell", clusts = c("CD14_monocyte", "CD16_monocyte"))
signaling_heatmap(dom)
signaling_heatmap(dom, scale = "sqrt")
signaling_heatmap(dom, normalize = "rec_norm")
gene_network(dom, clust = "CD16_monocyte", OutgoingSignalingClust = "CD14_monocyte")
gene_network(dom, clust = "CD16_monocyte", OutgoingSignalingClust = "CD14_monocyte", lig_scale = 25, layout = "sphere")
gene_network(dom, clust = "CD16_monocyte", OutgoingSignalingClust = "CD14_monocyte", cols = c(CD1D = "violet", LILRB2 = "violet", FOSB = "violet"), lig_scale = 10)
signaling_network(dom)
signaling_network(dom, showOutgoingSignalingClusts = "CD14_monocyte", scale = "none", norm = "none", layout = "fr", scale_by = "none", edge_weight = 2, vert_scale = 10)
circos_ligand_receptor(dom, receptor = "CD74", cell_colors = cols)
cor_scatter(dom, "FOSB", "CD74")
